quotes.author: Warren Buffett
quotes.quote: Our favorite holding period is forever.

quotes.author: Warren Buffett
quotes.quote: Price is what you pay. Value is what you get.

quotes.author: Warren Buffett
quotes.quote: It's far better to buy a wonderful company at a fair price than a fair company at a wonderful price.

quotes.author: Warren Buffett
quotes.quote: Be fearful when others are greedy, and greedy when others are fearful.

quotes.author: Warren Buffett
quotes.quote: Risk comes from not knowing what you're doing.

quotes.author: Warren Buffett
quotes.quote: If you aren't willing to own a stock for ten years, don't even think about owning it for ten minutes.

quotes.author: Warren Buffett
quotes.quote: Only when the tide goes out do you discover who has been swimming naked.

quotes.author: Warren Buffett
quotes.quote: Rule No. 1: Never lose money. Rule No. 2: Never forget Rule No. 1.

quotes.author: Warren Buffett
quotes.quote: The stock market is a device for transferring money from the impatient to the patient.

quotes.author: Warren Buffett
quotes.quote: We simply attempt to be fearful when others are greedy and to be greedy only when others are fearful.

quotes.author: Benjamin Graham
quotes.quote: An investment operation is one which, upon thorough analysis, promises safety of principal and a satisfactory return. Operations not meeting these requirements are speculative.

quotes.author: Benjamin Graham
quotes.quote: The intelligent investor is a realist who sells to optimists and buys from pessimists.

quotes.author: Benjamin Graham
quotes.quote: In the short run, the market is a voting machine, but in the long run, it is a weighing machine.

quotes.author: Benjamin Graham
quotes.quote: The essence of ultimate diversification is that the portfolio behaves like a diversified portfolio of all possible investment assets.

quotes.author: Benjamin Graham
quotes.quote: Obvious prospects for physical growth... do not necessarily translate into obvious profits for investors.

quotes.author: Benjamin Graham
quotes.quote: To achieve satisfactory investment results requires a combination of sound financial principles and emotional discipline.

quotes.author: Benjamin Graham
quotes.quote: The investor's chief problem—and even his worst enemy—is likely to be himself.

quotes.author: Benjamin Graham
quotes.quote: But investing isn't about beating others at their game. It's about controlling yourself at your own game.

quotes.author: Benjamin Graham
quotes.quote: The most realistic distinction between the investor and the speculator is found in their attitude toward stock market movements.

quotes.author: Benjamin Graham
quotes.quote: People who invest make money for themselves; people who speculate make money for their brokers.

quotes.author: Ray Dalio
quotes.quote: Pain + Reflection = Progress.

quotes.author: Ray Dalio
quotes.quote: Diversification is the most important thing you can do to manage risk effectively.

quotes.author: Ray Dalio
quotes.quote: The biggest mistake investors make is to believe that the future is going to be like the past.

quotes.author: Ray Dalio
quotes.quote: If you don’t have a 15-20 percent drawdown in your portfolio at least every five years, then you are probably not taking enough risks.

quotes.author: Ray Dalio
quotes.quote: The main reason for the failure of ordinary investors is that they are too emotional.

quotes.author: Ray Dalio
quotes.quote: Do not be fearful of missing out on a rally because you can always catch the next one.

quotes.author: Ray Dalio
quotes.quote: I believe that the best way to get a good read on the future is to look at the patterns of the past.

quotes.author: Ray Dalio
quotes.quote: Work hard, be creative, be smart, be honest, and good things will come to you.

quotes.author: Ray Dalio
quotes.quote: You can’t make money without taking risks, and you can’t make money without having some degree of pain.

quotes.author: Ray Dalio
quotes.quote: Principles are ways of successfully dealing with the laws of nature or the laws of life.

quotes.author: Jim Simons
quotes.quote: We search through historical data looking for anomalies that we expect to recur in the future.

quotes.author: Jim Simons
quotes.quote: Past performance is the best indicator of future success.

quotes.author: Jim Simons
quotes.quote: If you have a quantitative model, you can test it on a computer, and see if it works.

quotes.author: Jim Simons
quotes.quote: We’re right 50.75 percent of the time... but we’re 100 percent disciplined.

quotes.author: Jim Simons
quotes.quote: The market has memory.

quotes.author: Peter Lynch
quotes.quote: In this business, if you’re good, you’re right six times out of ten. You’re never going to be right nine times out of ten.

quotes.author: Peter Lynch
quotes.quote: Know what you own, and know why you own it.

quotes.author: Peter Lynch
quotes.quote: The best place to look for the next market winner is in your own backyard.

quotes.author: Peter Lynch
quotes.quote: Go for a walk around the mall. You might find a good investment.

quotes.author: Peter Lynch
quotes.quote: Behind every stock is a company. Find out what it's doing.

quotes.author: Peter Lynch
quotes.quote: If you spend 15 minutes a year on economics, you’re spending 12 minutes too much.

quotes.author: Peter Lynch
quotes.quote: It's not the employer who pays the wages. Employers only handle the money. It's the customer who pays the wages.

quotes.author: Peter Lynch
quotes.quote: I think you can make a lot of money in the market. But you don't need a lot of money to start.

quotes.author: Peter Lynch
quotes.quote: Your success in investing will depend on your ability to ignore the noise.

quotes.author: Larry Fink
quotes.quote: A company’s purpose is its compass.

quotes.author: Larry Fink
quotes.quote: Climate risk is investment risk.

quotes.author: Larry Fink
quotes.quote: Capitalism has the power to shape the future, but it must be inclusive and sustainable.

quotes.author: Larry Fink
quotes.quote: We are facing a retirement crisis. We need to help people invest for the long term.

quotes.author: Larry Fink
quotes.quote: Data is the new currency.

quotes.author: George Soros
quotes.quote: Markets are constantly in a state of uncertainty and flux and money is made by discounting the obvious and betting on the unexpected.

quotes.author: George Soros
quotes.quote: It's not whether you're right or wrong, but how much money you make when you're right and how much you lose when you're wrong.

quotes.author: George Soros
quotes.quote: The financial markets are inherently unstable; that’s why central banks can’t control them.

quotes.author: George Soros
quotes.quote: I am only rich because I know when I am wrong.

quotes.author: George Soros
quotes.quote: The reality is that financial markets are self-destabilizing; they don't tend towards equilibrium.

quotes.author: John Bogle
quotes.quote: Stay the course. The biggest risk of all is not taking enough risks.

quotes.author: John Bogle
quotes.quote: If you have trouble imagining a 20% loss in the stock market, you shouldn't be in stocks.

quotes.author: John Bogle
quotes.quote: The simple fact is that the investor’s return is the market’s return minus costs.

quotes.author: John Bogle
quotes.quote: Don't look for the needle in the haystack. Just buy the haystack!

quotes.author: John Bogle
quotes.quote: Time is your friend; impulse is your enemy.

quotes.author: John Bogle
quotes.quote: The mutual fund industry is a gigantic marketing machine.
